versions.content: Support subfunction 0x42 of UDS service 0x19 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support subfunction 0x42 of UDS service 0x19 to retrieve WWH-OBD-specific DTCs matching the requested DTC status mask and severity mask record. Rationale: Support of WWH-OBD Use Case: Improved fault and event tracking and analysis AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: Support of WWH-OBD
